title: Derived comparison for a specified finite affine Cech model
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be separated and quasi-compact with affine target, and $F$ a quasi-coherent module [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Supply independent derived localizations on $X$ and $T$ [def-pc-derived-category]. For any finite affine open covering $V:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$, there is an isomorphism $Q(C(f,F,V))\cong Rf_*(F[0])$, where $C$ is the specified section complex [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model] and $Rf_*$ is [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. No perfection, relative flatness or properness is asserted.

source.place: Tags 01XB, 01XD and 01FK; the acyclic-resolution comparison underlying 01XD

proof.text: Apply exists_finiteAffineCechModel_acyclic_resolution to obtain D, epsilon, the quasi-isomorphism of augmentation, termwise ordinary-direct-image acyclicity, and a chain isomorphism c from the pushed extension of D to finiteAffineCechModel. Consume these witnesses only in this proof.

Let K be D extended by zero and L its bounded-below object. moduleDirectImage preserves finite limits because it is Scheme.Modules.pushforward, a right adjoint. Extension preserves right-acyclic terms, including zero negative terms. Apply isIso_rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit_app_of_rightAcyclic. Whisker its inverse with the target bounded-below inclusion and compose with rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility and quotientCompQhIso on both sides, identifying Rf_*(Q K) with Q(f_* K). Source and target use independently supplied HasDerivedCategory instances throughout.

Extension preserves QuasiIso epsilon, so Q of the extended augmentation is invertible. Compose singleFunctorIsoCompQ and extendSingleIso with this map to identify F[0] with Q K. Apply Rf_* to that isomorphism. Compose its inverse with the inverse acyclic-complex comparison and the inverse of Q.mapIso c, yielding precisely Q(finiteAffineCechModel) to Rf_*(F[0]). These are mapIso, asIso and composition of existing isomorphisms.

lean.statement: theorem finiteAffineCechModel_derivedComparison {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) [IsAffine T] [IsSeparated f] [QuasiCompact f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{wT} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))] {r : ℕ} (V : Fin r → X.Opens) (hV : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (V i)) (hcover : iSup V = ⊤) : Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.Q (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))).obj (finiteAffineCechModel f F V) ≅ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj F))
